tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen background. Pure black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom bar, fields and chat bubbles on top of surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sunken areas inside a card: logs, blocks of Flipper data.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text. At least 17:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and descriptions. At least 5.9:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps and hints. 4.9:1 on surface-raised, so it meets 4.5:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside a card and between sections.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of fields and controls. 3.8:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Flipper orange. App bar of every screen, frame of the Flipper screen and brand marks. Not the button color.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Title, icons and text on the orange app bar: always black, 8.4:1.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Orange as text or icon on surface and surface-raised (6.8:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Faint orange background: Flipper tool cards in the chat.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Action blue. Primary pill buttons, links, action rows and the Connected state.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action. Black, 7.7:1 (white only reaches 2.7:1 and is hard to read in sunlight).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Running, correct. Text on surface or success-soft (at least 7:1).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Reserved. State is written as colored text, without tinted backgrounds.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Paused, connecting, warning. At least 11:1 on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Reserved. State is written as colored text, without tinted backgrounds.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Stopped, error, destructive actions as text. 4.6:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error strip and of a failed tool card.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (5.7:1); white does not reach it.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Claude turn in progress and neutral information; same blue as action.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the user bubble and of the turn indicator.

tokens.name: screen-bezel
tokens.usage: Outer 3px frame of the Flipper screen: orange at 50% on black.

tokens.name: screen-paper
tokens.usage: Background of the Flipper screen: the orange backlit LCD.

tokens.name: screen-pixel
tokens.usage: Lit pixels of the Flipper screen, black as on the device (9:1 on screen-paper).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring on every control (at least 6:1 on surface-raised).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Title of the orange app bar.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card title and settings row title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The agent acts directly; you pause it when needed.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, hints under a field, row descriptions.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: URLs, addresses, masked tokens, tool names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and text; pitch of the pixel pattern.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between pills, between lines of a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of pills, list rows and bubbles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of cards and rows. The side margin of a screen is 14px.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a section title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a touch control; large horizontal gap.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small labels, thumbnails, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, fields, chat bubbles and highlighted rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Outer frame of the Flipper screen; the inner one uses 12px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and status pills.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The only shadow: chat text field and controls when they float over scrolling content. Cards have no border or shadow: their color sets them apart from the black background.
